estimation in that day, \add as\add* a holy thing unto the \nd LORD\nd*.

In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was
bought, \add even\add* to him to whom the possession of the land
\add did belong\add*.

And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the
sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the \nd LORD’s\nd*
firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether \add it be\add* ox,
or sheep: it \add is\add* the \nd LORD’s\nd*.\f + \fr 27.26  \ft firstling of: Heb. firstborn,
etc\f*

And if \add it be\add* of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem
\add it\add* according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth
\add part\add* of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be
sold according to thy estimation.

Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote
unto the \nd LORD\nd* of all that he hath, \add both\add* of man
and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed:
every devoted thing \add is\add* most holy unto the \nd LORD\nd*.

None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed;
\add but\add* shall surely be put to death.

And all the tithe of the land, \add whether\add* of the seed
of the land, \add or\add* of the fruit of the tree, \add is\add*
the 
d LORD’s
d*: \add it is\add* holy unto the 
d LORD
d*.

And if a man will at all redeem \add ought\add* of his tithes,
he shall add thereto the fifth \add part\add* thereof.

And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, \add even\add*
of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the
\nd LORD\nd*.

He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he
change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change
thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

These \add are\add* the commandments, which the \nd LORD\nd*
commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

headers.toc1: The Fourth Book of Moses, called Numbers
headers.mt1: The Fourth Book of Moses, called Numbers

verses.text:
And the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto Moses in the wilderness of
Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first \add day\add*
of the second month, in the second year after they were come out
of the land of Egypt, saying,

From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth
to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one
head of the house of his fathers.

And these \add are\add* the names of the men that shall stand with you: of
\add the tribe of\add* Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of
Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.\f + \fr 1.14  \ft Deuel: also called,
Reuel\f*
Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

These \add  were\add* the renowned of the congregation, princes
of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by
\add their\add* names:

And they assembled all the congregation together on the first
\add day\add* of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees
after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the
number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

As the \nd LORD\nd* commanded  Moses, so he numbered them in the
wilderness of Sinai.

And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their
generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male
from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth
to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Reuben, \add were\add* forty and six thousand and five hundred.

Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their
families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered
of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every
male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth
to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Simeon, \add were\add* fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their
families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number
of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go
forth to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Gad, \add were\add* forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their
families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number
of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go
forth to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Judah, \add were\add* threescore and fourteen thousand and six
hundred.

Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their
families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number
of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go
forth to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Issachar, \add were\add* fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their
families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number
of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go
forth to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Zebulun, \add were\add* fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

Of the children of Joseph, \add namely\add*, of the children
of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house
of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty
years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Ephraim, \add were\add* forty thousand and five hundred.

Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their
families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number
of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go
forth to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Manasseh, \add were\add* thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their
families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number
of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go
forth to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Benjamin, \add were\add* thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their
families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number
of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go
forth to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Dan, \add were\add* threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their
families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number
of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go
forth to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Asher, \add were\add* forty and one thousand and five hundred.

Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations,
after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the
number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go
forth to war;

Those that were numbered of them, \add even\add* of the tribe
of Naphtali, \add were\add* fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

These \add are\add* those that were numbered, which Moses and
Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, \add being\add* twelve
men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand
and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not
numbered among them.

Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take
the sum of them among the children of Israel:

But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of
testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that
\add belong\add* to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the
vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp
round about the tabernacle.

And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it
down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it
up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every
man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their
hosts.

But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of
testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children
of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle
of testimony.

And the children of Israel did according to all that the \nd LORD\nd*
commanded Moses, so did they.
And the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own
standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about
the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.\f + \fr 2.2 
\ft far…: Heb. over against\f*

And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the
standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and
Nahshon the son of Amminadab \add shall be\add* captain of the children
of Judah.

And his host, and those that were numbered of them, \add were\add*
threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

And those that do pitch next unto him \add shall be\add* the
tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar \add shall be\add*
captain of the children of Issachar.

And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, \add were\add*
fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

\add Then\add* the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon
\add shall be\add* captain of the children of Zebulun.

And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, \add were\add*
fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

All that were numbered in the camp of Judah \add were\add*
an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four
hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.

On the south side \add shall be\add* the standard of the
camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the
children of Reuben \add shall be\add* Elizur the son of Shedeur.

And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, \add were\add*
forty and six thousand and five hundred.

And those which pitch by him \add shall be\add* the tribe
of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon \add shall be\add*
Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

And his host, and those that were numbered of them, \add were\add*
fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad
\add shall be\add* Eliasaph the son of Reuel.\f + \fr 2.14  \ft Reuel: also called,
Deuel\f*

And his host, and those that were numbered of them, \add were\add*
forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben \add were\add*
an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and
fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second
rank.

Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward
with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp,
so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.

On the west side \add shall be\add* the standard of the camp
of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons
of Ephraim \add shall be\add* Elishama the son of Ammihud.

And his host, and those that were numbered of them, \add were\add*
forty thousand and five hundred.

And by him \add shall be\add* the tribe of Manasseh: and the
captain of the children of Manasseh \add shall be\add* Gamaliel the
son of Pedahzur.

And his host, and those that were numbered of them, \add were\add*
thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of
Benjamin \add shall be\add* Abidan the son of Gideoni.

And his host, and those that were numbered of them, \add were\add*
thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim \add were\add*
an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their
armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.

The standard of the camp of Dan \add shall be\add* on the north
side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan \add shall
be\add* Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

And his host, and those that were numbered of them, \add were\add*
threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

And those that encamp by him \add shall be\add* the tribe
of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher \add shall be\add*
Pagiel the son of Ocran.

And his host, and those that were numbered of them, \add were\add*
forty and one thousand and five hundred.

Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children
of Naphtali \add shall be\add* Ahira the son of Enan.

And his host, and those that were numbered of them, \add were\add*
fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan \add were\add*
an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred.
They shall go hindmost with their standards.

These \add are\add* those which were numbered of the children
of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered
of the camps throughout their hosts \add were\add* six hundred thousand
and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel;
as the \nd LORD\nd* commanded Moses.

And the children of Israel did according to all that the \nd LORD\nd*
commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set
forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their
fathers.

These also \add are\add* the generations of Aaron and Moses
in the day \add that\add* the \nd LORD\nd* spake with Moses in mount
Sinai.

And these \add are\add* the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab
the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

These \add are\add* the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests
which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s
office.\f + \fr 3.3  \ft whom…: Heb. whose hand he filled\f*

And Nadab and Abihu died before the \nd LORD\nd*, when they
offered strange fire before the \nd LORD\nd*, in the wilderness of
Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s
office in the sight of Aaron their father.
And the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto Moses, saying,

Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron
the priest, that they may minister unto him.

And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole
congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the
service of the tabernacle.

And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the
congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the
service of the tabernacle.

And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they
\add are\add* wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.

And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait
on their priest’s office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to
death.
And the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto Moses, saying,

Because all the firstborn \add are\add* mine; \add for\add*
on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I
hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I
\add am\add* the \nd LORD\nd*.

And the \nd LORD\nd* spake  unto Moses in the wilderness
of Sinai, saying,

Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers,
by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou
number them.

And Moses numbered them according to the word of the \nd LORD\nd*,
as he was commanded.\f + \fr 3.16  \ft word: Heb. mouth\f*

And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and
Kohath, and Merari.

And these \add are\add* the names of the sons of Gershon by their
families; Libni, and Shimei.

And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar,
Hebron, and Uzziel.

And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These
\add  are\add* the families of the Levites according to the house
of their fathers.

Of Gershon \add was\add* the family of the Libnites, and the
family of the Shimites: these \add are\add* the families of the Gershonites.

Those that were numbered of them, according to the number
of all the males, from a month old and upward, \add even\add* those that were
numbered of them \add were\add* seven thousand and five hundred.

The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle
westward.

And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites
\add shall be\add* Eliasaph the son of Lael.

And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the
congregation \add shall be\add* the tabernacle, and the tent, the
covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle
of the congregation,

And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door
of the court, which \add is\add* by the tabernacle, and by the altar
round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

And of Kohath \add was\add* the family of the Amramites,
and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites,
and the family of the Uzzielites: these \add are\add* the families
of the Kohathites.

In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward,
\add were\add* eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge
of the sanctuary.

The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side
of the tabernacle southward.

And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the
Kohathites \add shall be\add* Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

And their charge \add shall be\add* the ark, and the table,
and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary
wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest \add shall be\add*
chief over the chief of the Levites, \add and have\add* the oversight
of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

Of Merari \add was\add* the family of the Mahlites, and the
family of the Mushites: these \add are\add* the families of Merari.

And those that were numbered of them, according to the number
of all the males, from a month old and upward, \add were\add* six
thousand and two hundred.

And the chief of the house of the father of the families of
Merari \add was\add* Zuriel the son of Abihail: \add these\add* shall
pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.

And \add under\add* the custody and charge of the sons of Merari
\add shall be\add* the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the
pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that
serveth thereto,\f + \fr 3.36  \ft under…: Heb. the office of the
charge\f*

And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets,
and their pins, and their cords.

But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east,
\add even\add* before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward,
\add shall be\add* Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge
of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the
stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron
numbered at the commandment of the \nd LORD\nd*, throughout their
families, all the males from a month old and upward, \add were\add*
twenty and two thousand.

And the \nd LORD\nd* said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn
of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward,
and take the number of their names.

And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I \add am\add* the
\nd LORD\nd*) instead of all the firstborn among the children of
Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings
among the cattle of the children of Israel.

And Moses numbered, as the \nd LORD\nd* commanded him, all the
firstborn among the children of Israel.

And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a
month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty
and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the
shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take \add them:\add* (the shekel
\add is\add* twenty gerahs:)

And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be
redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over
and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:

And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron
and to his sons, according to the word of the 
d LORD
d*, as the

d LORD
d* commanded Moses.
And the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi,
after their families, by the house of their fathers,

From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old,
all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the
congregation.

This \add shall be\add* the service of the sons of Kohath in the
tabernacle of the congregation, \add about\add* the most holy things:

And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his
sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark
of testimony with it:

And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall
spread over \add it\add* a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the
staves thereof.

And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of
blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls,
and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:\f + \fr 4.7 
\ft cover…: or, pour out withal\f*

And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover
the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the
staves thereof.

And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick
of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes,
and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a
covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put \add it\add* upon a bar.

And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue,
and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the
staves thereof:

And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they
minister in the sanctuary, and put \add them\add* in a cloth of blue,
and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put \add them\add*
on a bar:

And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread
a purple cloth thereon:

And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they
minister about it, \add even\add* the censers, the fleshhooks, and the
shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall
spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of
it.\f + \fr 4.14  \ft basons: or, bowls\f*

And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the
sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set
forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear \add it:\add*
but they shall not touch \add any\add* holy thing, lest they die. These
\add things are\add* the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle
of the congregation.

And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest
\add pertaineth\add* the oil for the light, and the sweet incense,
and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, \add and\add*
the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein \add is\add*,
in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
And the \nd LORD\nd* spake  unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites
from among the Levites:

But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they
approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in,
and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered,
lest they die.
And the \nd LORD\nd* spake  unto Moses, saying,

Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses
of their fathers, by their families;

From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou
number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the
work in the tabernacle of the congregation.\f + \fr 4.23  \ft to perform…: Heb. to war the
warfare\f*

This \add is\add* the service of the families of the Gershonites,
to serve, and for burdens:\f + \fr 4.24  \ft burdens: or, carriage\f*

And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the
tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the
badgers’ skins that \add is\add* above upon it, and the hanging for the
door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door
of the gate of the court, which \add is\add* by the tabernacle and by the
altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their
service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the
service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their
service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.\f + \fr 4.27 
\ft appointment: Heb. mouth\f*

This \add is\add* the service of the families of the sons of
Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge \add shall
be\add* under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their
families, by the house of their fathers;

From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old
shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service,
to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.\f + \fr 4.30 
\ft service: Heb. warfare\f*

And this \add is\add* the charge of their burden, according to all their
service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the
tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets,
and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their
service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge
of their burden.

This \add is\add* the service of the families of the sons of
Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the
congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered
the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house
of their fathers,

From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old,
every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle
of the congregation:

And those that were numbered of them by their families were two
thousand seven hundred and fifty.

These \add were\add* they that were numbered of the families
of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the
congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment
of the \nd LORD\nd* by the hand of Moses.

And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their
families, and by the house of their fathers,

From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old,
every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle
of the congregation,

be put to death.\f + \fr 35.17  \ft with…: Heb. with a stone of the
hand\f*

Or \add if\add* he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may
die, and he die, he \add is\add* a murderer: the murderer shall surely
be put to death.

The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he
meeteth him, he shall slay him.

But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of
wait, that he die;

Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that
smote \add him\add* shall surely be put to death; \add for\add* he
\add is\add* a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer,
when he meeteth him.

But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast
upon him any thing without laying of wait,

Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing \add him\add*
not, and cast \add it\add* upon him, that he die, and \add was\add*
not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the
revenger of blood according to these judgments:

And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand
of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the
city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the
death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border
of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the
city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of
blood:\f + \fr 35.27  \ft he…: Heb. no blood shall be to him\f*

Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge
until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high
priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

So these \add things\add* shall be for a statute of judgment
unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death
by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any
person \add to cause him\add* to die.

Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which
\add is\add* guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.\f + \fr 35.31 
\ft guilty…: Heb. faulty to die\f*

And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the
city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land,
until the death of the priest.

So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye \add are:\add*
for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the
blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.\f + \fr 35.33 
\ft the land cannot…: Heb. there can be no expiation for the land\f*

Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein
I dwell: for I the \nd LORD\nd* dwell among the children of Israel.

And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead,
the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons
of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes,
the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

And they said, The \nd LORD\nd* commanded my lord to give the
land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my
lord was commanded by the \nd LORD\nd* to give the inheritance of
Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

And if they be married to any of the sons of the \add other\add*
tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be
taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the
inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be
taken from the lot of our inheritance.\f + \fr 36.3  \ft whereunto…: Heb. unto whom they shall
be\f*

And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their
inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their
inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our
fathers.\f + \fr 36.4  \ft whereunto…: Heb. unto whom they shall
be\f*

And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the
word of the \nd LORD\nd*, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph
hath said well.

This \add is\add* the thing which the \nd LORD\nd* doth command
concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they
think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they
marry.\f + \fr 36.6  \ft marry: Heb. be wives\f*

So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove
from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall
keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.\f + \fr 36.7 
\ft keep…: Heb. cleave to the, etc\f*

And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe
of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the
tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every
man the inheritance of his fathers.

Neither shall the inheritance remove from \add one\add* tribe
to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of
Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

Even as the \nd LORD\nd* commanded Moses, so did the daughters
of Zelophehad:

For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the
daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’
sons:

\add And\add* they were married into the families of the sons
of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the
tribe of the family of their father.\f + \fr 36.12  \ft into…: Heb. to some that were of the
families\f*

These \add are\add* the commandments and the judgments, which the
\nd LORD\nd* commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of
Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan \add near\add* Jericho.

headers.toc1: The Fifth Book of Moses, called Deuteronomy
headers.mt1: The Fifth Book of Moses, called Deuteronomy

verses.text:
These \add be\add* the words which Moses spake unto all Israel
on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against
the Red \add sea\add*, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and
Hazeroth, and Dizahab.\f + \fr 1.1  \ft the Red…: or, Zuph\f*

(\add There are\add* eleven days’ \add journey\add* from Horeb
by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)

And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month,
on the first \add day\add* of the month, \add that\add* Moses spake
unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the \nd LORD\nd*
had given him in commandment unto them;

After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt
in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in
Edrei:

On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare
this law, saying,

The \nd LORD\nd* our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have
dwelt long enough in this mount:

Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the
Amorites, and unto all \add the places\add* nigh thereunto, in the
plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the
sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the
great river, the river Euphrates.\f + \fr 1.7  \ft all…: Heb. all his
neighbours\f*

Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the
land which the \nd LORD\nd* sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac,
and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.\f + \fr 1.8 
\ft set: Heb. given\f*

And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to
bear you myself alone:

The \nd LORD\nd* your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye
\add are\add* this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

(The \nd LORD\nd* God of your fathers make you a thousand times
so many more as ye \add are\add*, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)

How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden,
and your strife?

Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your
tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.\f + \fr 1.13  \ft Take: Heb.
Give\f*

And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken
\add is\add* good \add for us\add* to do.

So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and
made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over
hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and
officers among your tribes.\f + \fr 1.15  \ft made: Heb. gave\f*

And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear \add the
causes\add* between your brethren, and judge righteously between
\add every\add* man and his brother, and the stranger \add that is\add* with him.

Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; \add but\add* ye shall
hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the
face of man; for the judgment \add is\add* God’s: and the cause that is too
hard for you, bring \add it\add* unto me, and I will hear it.\f + \fr 1.17 
\ft respect…: Heb. acknowledge faces\f*

And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should
do.

And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that
great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain
of the Amorites, as the \nd LORD\nd* our God commanded us; and we
came to Kadesh-barnea.

And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the
Amorites, which the \nd LORD\nd* our God doth give unto us.

Behold, the \nd LORD\nd* thy God hath set the land before
thee: go up \add and\add* possess \add it\add*, as the \nd LORD\nd*
God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.

And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will
send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring
us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall
come.

And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you,
one of a tribe:

And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the
valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought
\add it\add* down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, \add It
is\add* a good land which the \nd LORD\nd* our God doth give us.

Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the
commandment of the \nd LORD\nd* your God:

And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the \nd LORD\nd*
hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver
us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our
heart, saying, The people \add is\add* greater and taller than we; the
cities \add are\add* great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have
seen the sons of the Anakims there.\f + \fr 1.28  \ft discouraged: Heb.
melted\f*
Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the \nd LORD\nd*
thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye
went, until ye came into this place.

Yet in this thing ye did not believe the \nd LORD\nd* your
God,

Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place
to pitch your tents \add in\add*, in fire by night, to shew you by what
way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

And the \nd LORD\nd* heard the voice of your words, and was
wroth, and sware, saying,

Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation
see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,

Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I
give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath
wholly followed the \nd LORD\nd*.\f + \fr 1.36  \ft wholly…: Heb. fulfilled to go
after\f*

Also the \nd LORD\nd* was angry with me for your sakes, saying,
Thou also shalt not go in thither.

\add But\add* Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before
thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel
to inherit it.

Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey,
and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good
and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall
possess it.

But \add as for\add* you, turn you, and take your journey into the
wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the
\nd LORD\nd*, we will go up and fight, according to all that the
\nd LORD\nd* our God commanded  us. And when ye had girded on every
man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.

And the \nd LORD\nd* said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up,
neither fight; for I \add am\add* not among you; lest ye be smitten
before your enemies.

So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the
commandment of the \nd LORD\nd*, and went presumptuously up into the
hill.\f + \fr 1.43  \ft went…: Heb. ye were presumptuous, and went
up\f*

And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against
you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, \add even\add*
unto Hormah.

And ye returned and wept before the 
d LORD
d*; but the

d LORD
d* would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye
abode \add there\add*.

Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the
way of the Red sea, as the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto me: and we compassed
mount Seir many days.
And the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto me, saying,
Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

And command thou the people, saying, Ye \add are\add* to pass
through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell
in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:

Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land,
no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir
unto Esau \add for\add* a possession.\f + \fr 2.5  \ft no…: Heb. even to the treading of the sole of the
foot\f*

Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also
buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

For the \nd LORD\nd* thy God hath blessed thee in all the works
of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness:
these forty years the \nd LORD\nd* thy God \add hath been\add* with thee; thou hast
lacked nothing.

And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau,
which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from
Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of
Moab.

And the \nd LORD\nd* said unto me, Distress not the Moabites,
neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their
land \add for\add* a possession; because I have given Ar unto the
children of Lot \add for\add* a possession.\f + \fr 2.9  \ft Distress…: or, Use no hostility against
Moab\f*

The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and
many, and tall, as the Anakims;

Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the
Moabites call them Emims.

The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children
of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before
them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his
possession, which the \nd LORD\nd* gave unto them.\f + \fr 2.12 
\ft succeeded: Heb. inherited\f*\f + \fr 2.12  \ft stead: or, room\f*

Now rise up, \add said I\add*, and get you over the brook
Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.\f + \fr 2.13  \ft brook: or,
valley\f*

And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come
over the brook Zered, \add was\add* thirty and eight years; until all the
generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host,
as the \nd LORD\nd* sware unto them.\f + \fr 2.14  \ft brook: or,
valley\f*

For indeed the hand of the \nd LORD\nd* was against them, to
destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed
and dead from among the people,
That the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto me, saying,

Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this
day:

And \add when\add* thou comest nigh over against the children
of Ammon, distress  them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not
give thee of the land of the children of Ammon \add any\add* possession;
because I have given it unto the children of Lot \add for\add* a
possession.

(That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old
time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;\f + \fr 2.20  \ft Zamzummims: also called,
Zuzims\f*

A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the
\nd LORD\nd* destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and
dwelt in their stead:

As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he
destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and
dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, \add even\add* unto
Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed
them, and dwelt in their stead.)

Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon:
behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon,
and his land: begin to possess \add it\add*, and contend with him in
battle.\f + \fr 2.24  \ft begin…: Heb. begin, possess\f*

This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear
of thee upon the nations \add that are\add* under the whole heaven,
who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish
because of thee.

And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto
Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high
way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

(As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites
which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the
land which the \nd LORD\nd* our God giveth us.

But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the
\nd LORD\nd* thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate,
that he might deliver him into thy hand, as \add appeareth\add* this
day.

And the \nd LORD\nd* said unto me, Behold, I have begun to
give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest
inherit his land.

Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to
fight at Jahaz.

And the \nd LORD\nd* our God delivered him before us; and we
smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed
the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left
none to remain:\f + \fr 2.34  \ft the men…: Heb. every city of men, and women, and little
ones\f*

Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the
spoil of the cities which we took.

From Aroer, which \add is\add* by the brink of the river of
Arnon, and \add from\add* the city that \add is\add* by the river,
even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the \nd LORD\nd*
our God delivered all unto us:

Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not,
\add nor\add* unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities
in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the \nd LORD\nd* our God forbad
 us.

Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king
of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at
Edrei.

And the \nd LORD\nd* said unto me, Fear him not: for I will
deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt
do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which
dwelt at Heshbon.

So the \nd LORD\nd* our God delivered into our hands Og also, the
king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was
left to him remaining.

And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city
which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of
Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

All these cities \add were\add* fenced with high walls, gates,
and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of
Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every
city.

But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a
prey to ourselves.

(\add Which\add* Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites
call it Shenir;)

All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan,
unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants;
behold, his bedstead \add was\add* a bedstead of iron; \add is\add*
it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits \add was\add*
the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the
cubit of a man.

And this land, \add which\add* we possessed at that time,
from Aroer, which \add is\add* by the river Arnon, and half mount
Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the
Gadites.

And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, \add being\add* the
kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region
of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the
coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name,
Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.
And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast \add thereof\add*,
from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, \add even\add* the
salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.\f + \fr 3.17  \ft Ashdoth-pisgah: or, the springs of Pisgah, or, the
hill\f*

And I commanded you at that time, saying, The \nd LORD\nd*
your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over
armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all \add that
are\add* meet for the war.\f + \fr 3.18  \ft meet…: Heb. sons of
power\f*

Until the \nd LORD\nd* have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and
\add until\add* they also possess the land which the \nd LORD\nd*
your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and \add then\add* shall ye
return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have
seen all that the \nd LORD\nd* your God hath done unto these two
kings: so shall the \nd LORD\nd* do unto all the kingdoms whither thou
passest.

Ye shall not fear them: for the \nd LORD\nd* your God he shall
fight for you.
And I besought the \nd LORD\nd* at that time, saying,

O Lord \nd GOD\nd*, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy
greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God \add is there\add* in
heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy
might?

I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that \add is\add*
beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

But the 
d LORD
d* was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not
hear me: and the 
d LORD
d* said unto me, Let it suffice thee;
speak no more unto me of this matter.

Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes
westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold
\add it\add* with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.\f + \fr 3.27 
\ft Pisgah: or, the hill\f*

But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go
over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land
which thou shalt see.
So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the
judgments, which I teach you, for to do \add them\add*, that ye may
live, and go in and possess the land which the \nd LORD\nd* God of your
fathers giveth you.

Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye
diminish \add ought\add* from it, that ye may keep the commandments
of the \nd LORD\nd* your God which I command you.

Your eyes have seen what the 
d LORD
d* did because of Baal-peor:
for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the 
d LORD
d* thy God
hath destroyed them from among you.

But ye that did cleave unto the \nd LORD\nd* your God \add are\add*
alive every one of you this day.

Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the
\nd LORD\nd* my God commanded  me, that ye should do so in the land
whither ye go to possess it.

Keep therefore and do \add them;\add* for this \add is\add*
your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall
hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation \add is\add*
a wise and understanding people.

For what nation \add is there so\add* great, who \add hath\add*
God \add so\add* nigh unto them, as the \nd LORD\nd* our God \add is\add* in all
\add things that\add* we call upon him \add for\add*?

And what nation \add is there so\add* great, that hath statutes
and judgments \add so\add* righteous as all this law, which I set
before you this day?

\add Specially\add* the day that thou stoodest before the
\nd LORD\nd* thy God in Horeb, when the \nd LORD\nd* said unto me,
Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words,
that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live
upon the earth, and \add that\add* they may teach their children.

And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain
burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds,
and thick darkness.\f + \fr 4.11  \ft midst: Heb. heart\f*

And the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto you out of the midst of the
fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only
\add ye heard\add* a voice.\f + \fr 4.12  \ft only…: Heb. save a
voice\f*

And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded
you to perform, \add even\add* ten commandments; and he wrote them upon
two tables of stone.

And the \nd LORD\nd* commanded  me at that time to teach
you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go
over to possess it.

Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of
similitude on the day \add that\add* the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto you in
Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

Lest ye corrupt \add yourselves\add*, and make you a graven
image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

The likeness of any beast that \add is\add* on the earth,
the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the
likeness of any fish that \add is\add* in the waters beneath the
earth:

And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou

See now that I, \add even\add* I, \add am\add* he, and \add there
