heal: neither \add is there any\add* that can deliver out of my hand.
For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on
judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward
them that hate me.

I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall
devour flesh; \add and that\add* with the blood of the slain and of the
captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

Rejoice, O ye nations, \add with\add* his people: for he will
avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his
adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, \add and\add* to his
people.\f + \fr 32.43  \ft Rejoice…: or, Praise his people, ye nations: or, Sing
ye\f*

And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the
ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.\f + \fr 32.44 
\ft Hoshea: or, Joshua\f*
And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:

And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words
which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children
to observe to do, all the words of this law.

For it \add is\add* not a vain thing for you; because it \add is\add*
your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong \add your\add*
days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
And the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, \add unto\add* mount
Nebo, which \add is\add* in the land of Moab, that \add is\add* over
against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the
children of Israel for a possession:

And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered
unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was
gathered unto his people:

Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel
at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye
sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.\f + \fr 32.51 
\ft Meribah-Kadesh: or, strife at Kadesh\f*

Yet thou shalt see the land before \add thee;\add* but thou shalt not
go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.

And this \add is\add* the blessing, wherewith Moses the man
of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

And he said, The \nd LORD\nd* came from Sinai, and rose up
from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came
with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand \add went\add*
a fiery law for them.\f + \fr 33.2  \ft a fiery…: Heb. a fire of
law\f*

Yea, he loved the people; all his saints \add are\add* in thy
hand: and they sat down at thy feet; \add every one\add* shall receive
of thy words.

Moses commanded us a law, \add even\add* the inheritance of the
congregation of Jacob.

And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people \add and\add*
the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

Let Reuben live, and not die; and let \add not\add* his men
be few.

And this \add is the blessing\add* of Judah: and he said,
Hear, \nd LORD\nd*, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people:
let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help \add to
him\add* from his enemies.

Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen
him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children:
for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.

They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law:
they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine
altar.\f + \fr 33.10  \ft They shall teach: or, Let them teach\f*\f + \fr 33.10 
\ft they shall put: or, let them put\f*\f + \fr 33.10  \ft before…: Heb. at thy
nose\f*

Bless, \nd LORD\nd*, his substance, and accept the work of his
hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that
hate him, that they rise not again.

\add And\add* of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the \nd LORD\nd*
shall dwell in safety by him; \add and the \+nd Lord\+nd*\add* shall
cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.

And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the \nd LORD\nd* \add be\add*
his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the
deep that coucheth beneath,

And for the precious fruits \add brought forth\add* by the
sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,\f + \fr 33.14 
\ft put: Heb. thrust\f*\f + \fr 33.14  \ft moon: Heb. moons\f*

And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious
things of the lasting hills,

And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and
\add for\add* the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let \add the
blessing\add* come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the
head of him \add that was\add* separated from his brethren.

His glory \add is like\add* the firstling of his bullock,
and his horns \add are like\add* the horns of unicorns: with them he shall
push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they \add are\add*
the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they \add are\add* the thousands
of Manasseh.\f + \fr 33.17  \ft unicorns: Heb. an unicorn\f*

And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out;
and, Issachar, in thy tents.

They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall
offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck \add of\add*
the abundance of the seas, and \add of\add* treasures hid in the
sand.

And of Gad he said, Blessed \add be\add* he that enlargeth
Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the
head.

And he provided the first part for himself, because there,
\add in\add* a portion of the lawgiver, \add was he\add* seated;
and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice
of the \nd LORD\nd*, and his judgments with Israel.\f + \fr 33.21 
\ft seated: Heb. cieled\f*

And of Dan he said, Dan \add is\add* a lion’s whelp: he shall
leap from Bashan.

And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour,
and full with the blessing of the \nd LORD\nd*: possess thou the
west and the south.

And of Asher he said, \add Let\add* Asher \add be\add* blessed
with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him
dip his foot in oil.

Thy shoes \add shall be\add* iron and brass; and as thy days,
\add so shall\add* thy strength \add be\add*.\f + \fr 33.25  \ft Thy shoes: or, Under thy
shoes\f*

\add There is\add* none like unto the God of Jeshurun, \add who\add*
rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the
sky.

The eternal God \add is thy\add* refuge, and underneath \add are\add*
the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before
thee; and shall say, Destroy \add them\add*.

Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob
\add shall be\add* upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens
shall drop down dew.

Happy \add art\add* thou, O Israel: who \add is\add* like unto thee, O
people saved by the \nd LORD\nd*, the shield of thy help, and who
\add is\add* the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found
liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.\f + \fr 33.29 
\ft found…: or, subdued\f*

And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain
of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that \add is\add* over against Jericho.
And the \nd LORD\nd* shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,\f + \fr 34.1 
\ft Pisgah: or, the hill\f*

And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the
land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the
city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

And the \nd LORD\nd* said unto him, This \add is\add* the land
which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will
give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see \add it\add* with thine
eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.

So Moses the servant of the 
d LORD
d* died there in the
land of Moab, according to the word of the 
d LORD
d*.

And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against
Beth-peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.

And Moses \add was\add* an hundred and twenty years old when he
died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.\f + \fr 34.7 
\ft natural…: Heb. moisture\f*\f + \fr 34.7  \ft abated: Heb. fled\f*

And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of
Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping \add and\add* mourning for
Moses were ended.

And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses,
whom the \nd LORD\nd* knew face to face,

In all the signs and the wonders, which the \nd LORD\nd* sent
him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants,
and to all his land,

And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which
Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.

headers.toc1: The Book of Joshua
headers.mt1: The Book of Joshua

verses.text:
Now after the death of Moses the servant of the 
d LORD
d*
it came to pass, that the 
d LORD
d* spake unto Joshua the son
of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,

Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this
Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them,
\add even\add* to the children of Israel.

Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I
given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river,
the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great
sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the
days of thy life: as I was with Moses, \add so\add* I will be with thee: I will not
fail thee, nor forsake thee.

Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an
inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.\f + \fr 1.6 
\ft unto this…: or, thou shalt cause this people to inherit the land,
etc\f*

Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe
to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded
thee: turn not from it \add to\add* the right hand or \add to\add*
the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.\f + \fr 1.7 
\ft prosper: or, do wisely\f*

This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt
meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is
written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good
success.\f + \fr 1.8  \ft have…: or, do wisely\f*
Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare
you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan,
to go in to possess the land, which the \nd LORD\nd* your God giveth
 you to possess it.

And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the
tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

Remember the word which Moses the servant of the 
d LORD
d*
commanded you, saying, The 
d LORD
d* your God hath given you rest,
and hath given you this land.

Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain
in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall
pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and
help them;\f + \fr 1.14  \ft armed: Heb. marshalled by five\f*

Until the \nd LORD\nd* have given your brethren rest, as \add he hath
given\add* you, and they also have possessed the land which the \nd LORD\nd*
your God giveth  them: then ye shall return unto the land of your
possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the \nd LORD’s\nd* servant
gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest
us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.

According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we
hearken unto thee: only the \nd LORD\nd* thy God be with thee, as he was with
Moses.

Whosoever \add he be\add* that doth rebel against thy commandment,
and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to
death: only be strong and of a good courage.

And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy
secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went,
and came into an harlot’s house, named Rahab, and lodged there.\f + \fr 2.1 
\ft sent: or, had sent\f*\f + \fr 2.1  \ft lodged: Heb. lay\f*

And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there
came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out
the country.

And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth
the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house:
for they be come to search out all the country.

And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There
came men unto me, but I wist not whence they \add were:\add*

And it came to pass \add about the time\add* of shutting of the
gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went
I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid
them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the
roof.

And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords:
and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they
shut the gate.

And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the
roof;

And she said unto the men, I know that the \nd LORD\nd* hath
given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the
inhabitants of the land faint because of you.\f + \fr 2.9  \ft faint: Heb.
melt\f*

For we have heard how the \nd LORD\nd* dried up the water
of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did
unto the two kings of the Amorites, that \add were\add* on the other
side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

And as soon as we had heard \add these things\add*, our hearts
did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because
of you: for the \nd LORD\nd* your God, he \add is\add* God in heaven
above, and in earth beneath.\f + \fr 2.11  \ft did there…: Heb. rose
up\f*

Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the \nd LORD\nd*,
since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness
unto my father’s house, and give me a true token:

And \add that\add* ye will save alive my father, and my mother,
and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver
our lives from death.

And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter
not this our business. And it shall be, when the \nd LORD\nd* hath
given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.\f + \fr 2.14 
\ft for…: Heb. instead of you to die\f*

Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her
house \add was\add* upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the
pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the
pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

And the men said unto her, We \add will be\add* blameless
of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

Behold, \add when\add* we come into the land, thou shalt bind
this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down
by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren,
and all thy father’s household, home unto thee.\f + \fr 2.18  \ft bring: Heb.
gather\f*

And it shall be, \add that\add* whosoever shall go out of the
doors of thy house into the street, his blood \add shall be\add*
upon his head, and we \add will be\add* guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the
house, his blood \add shall be\add* on our head, if \add any\add*
hand be upon him.

And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit
of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

And she said, According unto your words, so \add be\add* it. And she sent them
away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there
three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought
\add them\add* throughout all the way, but found \add them\add* not.

So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain,
and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all
\add things\add* that befell them:

And they said unto Joshua, Truly the \nd LORD\nd* hath delivered
into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the
country do faint because of us.\f + \fr 2.24  \ft faint: Heb. melt\f*

And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from
Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and
lodged there before they passed over.

And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went
through the host;

And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark
of the covenant of the \nd LORD\nd* your God, and the priests the
Levites bearing  it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go
after it.

Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand
cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way
by which ye must go: for ye have not passed \add this\add* way heretofore.\f + \fr 3.4 
\ft heretofore: Heb. since yesterday, and the third day\f*

And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to
morrow the \nd LORD\nd* will do wonders among you.

And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark
of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up
the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

And the \nd LORD\nd* said unto Joshua, This day will I begin
to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with
Moses, \add so\add* I will be with thee.

And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the
covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan,
ye shall stand still in Jordan.

And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither,
and hear the words of the \nd LORD\nd* your God.

And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God
\add is\add* among you, and \add that\add* he will without fail drive
out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites,
and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the
Jebusites.

Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth
passeth over before you into Jordan.

Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel,
out of every tribe a man.

And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet
of the priests that bear the ark of the \nd LORD\nd*, the Lord of all the
earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, \add that\add* the waters
of Jordan shall be cut off \add from\add* the waters that come down
from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the
feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the
water, (for Jordan overfloweth  all his banks all the time of harvest,)

That the waters which came down from above stood \add and\add*
rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that \add is\add*
beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain,
\add even\add* the salt sea, failed, \add and\add* were cut off:
and the people passed over right against Jericho.

And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the \nd LORD\nd*
stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites
passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean
over Jordan.

And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed
over Jordan, that the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto Joshua, saying,

Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a
man,

And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst
of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve
stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging
place, where ye shall lodge this night.

Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the
children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the
\nd LORD\nd* your God into the midst of Jordan, and take ye up every
man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the
tribes of the children of Israel:

That this may be a sign among you, \add that\add* when your
children ask \add their fathers\add* in time to come, saying, What
\add mean\add* ye by these stones?\f + \fr 4.6  \ft in time…: Heb. to
morrow\f*

Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut
off before the ark of the covenant of the \nd LORD\nd*; when it passed
over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones
shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.

And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took
up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the \nd LORD\nd*
spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children
of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they
lodged, and laid them down there.

And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the
feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this
day.

For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of
Jordan, until every thing was finished that the \nd LORD\nd* commanded
Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded
 Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed
over, that the ark of the \nd LORD\nd* passed over, and the priests,
in the presence of the people.

And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half
the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel,
as Moses spake unto them:

About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the
\nd LORD\nd* unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.\f + \fr 4.13 
\ft prepared: or, ready armed\f*

On that day the \nd LORD\nd* magnified Joshua in the sight
of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the
days of his life.
And the \nd LORD\nd* spake unto Joshua, saying,

Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come
up out of Jordan.

Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up
out of Jordan.

And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the
covenant of the \nd LORD\nd* were come up out of the midst of Jordan,
\add and\add* the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry
land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed
over all his banks, as \add they did\add* before.\f + \fr 4.18  \ft lifted…: Heb. plucked
up\f*\f + \fr 4.18  \ft flowed: Heb. went\f*

And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth \add day\add*
of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of
Jericho.

And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did
Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your
children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What \add mean\add*
these stones?\f + \fr 4.21  \ft in time…: Heb. to morrow\f*

Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came
over this Jordan on dry land.

For the \nd LORD\nd* your God dried up the waters of Jordan
from before you, until ye were passed over, as the \nd LORD\nd* your
God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone
over:

That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the
\nd LORD\nd*, that it \add is\add* mighty: that ye might fear the
\nd LORD\nd* your God for ever.\f + \fr 4.24  \ft for ever: Heb. all
days\f*

And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which
\add were\add* on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings
of the Canaanites, which \add were\add* by the sea, heard that the
\nd LORD\nd* had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children
of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there
spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.

At that time the \nd LORD\nd* said unto Joshua, Make thee
sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second
time.\f + \fr 5.2  \ft sharp…: or, knives of flints\f*

And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children
of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.\f + \fr 5.3  \ft sharp…: or, knives of
flints\f*\f + \fr 5.3  \ft the hill…: or, Gibeah-haaraloth\f*

And this \add is\add* the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the
people that came out of Egypt, \add that were\add* males, \add even\add*
all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came
out of Egypt.

Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the
people \add that were\add* born in the wilderness by the way as they came
forth out of Egypt, \add them\add* they had not circumcised.

For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness,
till all the people \add that were\add* men of war, which came out
of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the
\nd LORD\nd*: unto whom the \nd LORD\nd* sware that he would not
shew them the land, which the \nd LORD\nd* sware unto their fathers
that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

And their children, \add whom\add* he raised up in their stead, them
Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not
circumcised them by the way.

And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the
people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were
whole.\f + \fr 5.8  \ft they had…: Heb. the people had made an end to be
circumcised\f*

And the \nd LORD\nd* said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled
away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the
place is called Gilgal unto this day.\f + \fr 5.9  \ft Gilgal: that is
Rolling\f*

And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the
passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains
of Jericho.

And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow
after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched \add corn\add*
in the selfsame day.

And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old
corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did
eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted
up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his

thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our
children, saying, What have ye to do with the \nd LORD\nd* God of
Israel?\f + \fr 22.24  \ft In time…: Heb. To morrow\f*

For the 
d LORD
d* hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye
children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the 
d LORD
d*:
so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the 
d LORD
d*.

Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar,
not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

But \add that\add* it \add may be\add* a witness between us, and you, and our
generations after us, that we might do the service of the \nd LORD\nd*
before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace
offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to
come, Ye have no part in the \nd LORD\nd*.

Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should \add so\add*
say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say
\add again\add*, Behold the pattern of the altar of the \nd LORD\nd*,
which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it
\add is\add* a witness between us and you.

God forbid that we should rebel against the 
d LORD
d*,
and turn this day from following the 
d LORD
d*, to build an altar
for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the
altar of the 
d LORD
d* our God that \add is\add* before his tabernacle.

And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation
and heads of the thousands of Israel which \add were\add* with him,
heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad
and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.\f + \fr 22.30 
\ft pleased…: Heb. was good in their eyes\f*

And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children
of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh,
This day we perceive that the \nd LORD\nd* \add is\add* among us, because ye have not
committed this trespass against the \nd LORD\nd*: now ye have delivered
the children of Israel out of the hand of the \nd LORD\nd*.\f + \fr 22.31 
\ft now: Heb. then\f*

And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes,
returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad,
out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children
of Israel, and brought them word again.

And the thing pleased  the children of Israel; and the children
of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in
battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad
dwelt.

And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called
the altar \add Ed:\add* for it \add shall be\add* a witness between us that the
\nd LORD\nd* \add is\add* God.\f + \fr 22.34  \ft Ed: that is, A
witness\f*

And it came to pass a long time after that the \nd LORD\nd*
had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that
Joshua waxed old \add and\add* stricken in age.\f + \fr 23.1  \ft stricken…: Heb. come into
days\f*

And Joshua called for all Israel, \add and\add* for their elders,
and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers,
and said unto them, I am old \add and\add* stricken in age:

And ye have seen all that the 
d LORD
d* your God hath done
unto all these nations because of you; for the 
d LORD
d* your
God \add is\add* he that hath fought for you.

Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain,
to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations
that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.\f + \fr 23.4 
\ft westward: Heb. at the sunset\f*

And the 
d LORD
d* your God, he shall expel them from before
you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess
their land, as the 
d LORD
d* your God hath promised unto you.

That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make
mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear \add by them\add*,
neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

But cleave unto the \nd LORD\nd* your God, as ye have done
unto this day.\f + \fr 23.8  \ft But cleave…: or, For if ye will cleave,
etc\f*

For the \nd LORD\nd* hath driven out from before you great
nations and strong: but \add as for\add* you, no man hath been able to
stand before you unto this day.\f + \fr 23.9  \ft For the \+nd LORD\+nd*…: or, Then the
\+nd LORD\+nd* will drive\f*

One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the \nd LORD\nd*
your God, he \add it is\add* that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the
\nd LORD\nd* your God.\f + \fr 23.11  \ft yourselves: Heb. your souls\f*

Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant
of these nations, \add even\add* these that remain among you, and shall make
marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

Know for a certainty that the \nd LORD\nd* your God will no
more drive out \add any of\add* these nations from before you; but they shall be
snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns
in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the \nd LORD\nd*
your God hath given you.

And, behold, this day I \add am\add* going the way of all the
earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not
one thing hath failed of all the good things which the \nd LORD\nd*
your God spake  concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, \add and\add*
not one thing hath failed thereof.

Therefore it shall come to pass, \add that\add* as all good
things are come upon you, which the 
d LORD
d* your God promised
you; so shall the 
d LORD
d* bring upon you all evil things, until he have
destroyed you from off this good land which the 
d LORD
d* your
God hath given you.

When ye have transgressed the covenant of the \nd LORD\nd*
your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other
gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the \nd LORD\nd*
be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the
good land which he hath given unto you.

And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and
called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their
judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before
God.

And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the \nd LORD\nd*
God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood
in old time, \add even\add* Terah, the father of Abraham, and the
father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood,
and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his
seed, and gave him Isaac.

And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau
mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into
Egypt.

I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that
which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the
sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and
horsemen unto the Red sea.

And when they cried unto the \nd LORD\nd*, he put darkness
between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and
covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt:
and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt
on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your
hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from
before you.

Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred
against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed
you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men
of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites,
and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites,
and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from
before you, \add even\add* the two kings of the Amorites; \add but\add*
not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and
cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards
and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

Now therefore fear the \nd LORD\nd*, and serve him in sincerity
and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other
side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the \nd LORD\nd*.

And if it seem evil unto you to serve the \nd LORD\nd*, choose
you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers
served that \add were\add* on the other side of the flood, or the
gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my
house, we will serve the \nd LORD\nd*.

And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should
forsake the \nd LORD\nd*, to serve other gods;

For the \nd LORD\nd* our God, he \add it is\add* that brought us
up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage,
and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the
way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

And the 
d LORD
d* drave out from before us all the people,
even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: \add therefore\add* will we also
serve the 
d LORD
d*; for he \add is\add* our God.

And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the \nd LORD\nd*: for he
\add is\add* an holy God; he \add is\add* a jealous God; he will not
forgive your transgressions nor your sins.\f + \fr 24.19  \ft holy God: Heb. holy
Gods\f*

If ye forsake the \nd LORD\nd*, and serve strange gods, then he will
turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you
good.

And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the
\nd LORD\nd*.

And Joshua said unto the people, Ye \add are\add* witnesses
against yourselves that ye have chosen you the \nd LORD\nd*, to serve
him. And they said, \add We are\add* witnesses.

Now therefore put away, \add said he\add*, the strange gods which
\add are\add* among you, and incline your heart unto the \nd LORD\nd*
God of Israel.

And the people said unto Joshua, The \nd LORD\nd* our God
will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set
them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God,
and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that \add was\add*
by the sanctuary of the \nd LORD\nd*.

And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a
witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the \nd LORD\nd*
which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye
deny your God.
So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son
of Nun, the servant of the \nd LORD\nd*, died, \add being\add* an
hundred and ten years old.

And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-serah, which
\add is\add* in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

And Israel served the \nd LORD\nd* all the days of Joshua,
and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had
known all the works of the \nd LORD\nd*, that he had done for Israel.\f + \fr 24.31 
\ft overlived…: Heb. prolonged their days after Joshua\f*

And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought
up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which
Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred
pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of
Joseph.\f + \fr 24.32  \ft pieces…: or, lambs\f*

And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a
hill \add that pertained to\add* Phinehas his son, which was given
him in mount Ephraim.

headers.toc1: The Book of Judges
headers.mt1: The Book of Judges

verses.text:
Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children
of Israel asked the \nd LORD\nd*, saying, Who shall go up for us against the
Canaanites first, to fight against them?

And the \nd LORD\nd* said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have
delivered the land into his hand.

And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my
lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will
go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

And Judah went up; and the \nd LORD\nd* delivered the Canaanites
and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek
ten thousand men.

And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they
slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught
him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their
thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered \add their meat\add*
under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they
brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.\f + \fr 1.7  \ft their thumbs…: Heb. the thumbs of their hands and of their
feet\f*\f + \fr 1.7  \ft gathered: or, gleaned\f*

Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had
taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the
city on fire.

And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the
Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the
valley.\f + \fr 1.9  \ft valley: or, low country\f*

And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron:
(now the name of Hebron before \add was\add* Kirjath-arba:) and they
slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir:
and the name of Debir before \add was\add* Kirjath-sepher:

And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh
it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took
it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

And it came to pass, when she came \add to him\add*, that she
moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off
\add her\add* ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?

And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given
me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the
upper springs and the nether springs.

And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went
up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the
wilderness of Judah, which \add lieth\add* in the south of Arad;
and they went and dwelt among the people.

And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the
Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the
name of the city was called Hormah.

Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the
coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.

And the \nd LORD\nd* was with Judah; and he drave out \add the inhabitants
of\add* the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the
valley, because they had chariots of iron.\f + \fr 1.19  \ft drave…: or, possessed the
mountain\f*

And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled
thence the three sons of Anak.

And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites
that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children
of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Beth-el:
and the \nd LORD\nd* \add was\add* with them.

And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth-el. (Now the name
of the city before \add was\add* Luz.)

And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they
said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city,
and we will shew thee mercy.

And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote
the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his
family.

And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built
a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which \add is\add* the name
thereof unto this day.

Neither did Manasseh drive out \add the inhabitants of\add*
Beth-shean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants
of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns,
nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites
would dwell in that land.

And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put
the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.

Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in
Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron,
nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became
tributaries.

Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the
inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah,
nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:

But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants
of the land: for they did not drive them out.

Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh,
nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites,
the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh
and of Beth-anath became tributaries unto them.

And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain:
for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:

But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in
Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became
tributaries.\f + \fr 1.35  \ft prevailed: Heb. was heavy\f*

And the coast of the Amorites \add was\add* from the going
up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.\f + \fr 1.36  \ft the going…: or,
Maaleh-acrabbim\f*

And an angel of the \nd LORD\nd* came up from Gilgal to Bochim,
and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the
land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break
my covenant with you.\f + \fr 2.1  \ft angel: or, messenger\f*

Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be
\add as thorns\add* in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.

And it came to pass, when the angel of the \nd LORD\nd* spake
these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted
up their voice, and wept.

And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed
there unto the \nd LORD\nd*.\f + \fr 2.5  \ft Bochim: that is, Weepers\f*

And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel
went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.

And the people served the \nd LORD\nd* all the days of Joshua,
and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen
all the great works of the \nd LORD\nd*, that he did for Israel.\f + \fr 2.7 
\ft outlived: Heb. prolonged days after\f*

And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the \nd LORD\nd*,
died, \add being\add* an hundred and ten years old.

And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath-heres,
in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.\f + \fr 2.9 
\ft Timnath-heres: also called, Timnath-serah\f*

And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers:
and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the
\nd LORD\nd*, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.

And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the \nd LORD\nd*,
and served Baalim:

And they forsook the \nd LORD\nd* God of their fathers, which brought them
out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the
people that \add were\add* round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the
\nd LORD\nd* to anger.
And they forsook the \nd LORD\nd*, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.

And the anger of the \nd LORD\nd* was hot against Israel,
and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he
sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they
could not any longer stand before their enemies.

Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the 
d LORD
d*
was against them for evil, as the 
d LORD
d* had said, and as the

d LORD
d* had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.

Nevertheless the \nd LORD\nd* raised up judges, which delivered
them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.\f + \fr 2.16  \ft delivered: Heb.
saved\f*

And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a
whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned
quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the
commandments of the \nd LORD\nd*; \add but\add* they did not so.

And when the 
d LORD
d* raised them up judges, then the

d LORD
d* was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand
of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the 
d LORD
d*
because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and
vexed them.

And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, \add that\add*
they returned, and corrupted \add themselves\add* more than their
fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they
ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.\f + \fr 2.19 
\ft corrupted…: or, were corrupt\f*\f + \fr 2.19  \ft ceased…: Heb. let nothing fall of
their\f*

I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the
nations which Joshua left when he died:

That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep
the way of the \nd LORD\nd* to walk therein, as their fathers did
keep \add it\add*, or not.

Therefore the \nd LORD\nd* left those nations, without driving them
out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.\f + \fr 2.23 
\ft left: or, suffered\f*

Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know,
to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;

\add Namely\add*, five lords of the Philistines, and all the
Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount
Lebanon, from mount Baal-hermon unto the entering in of Hamath.

And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would
hearken unto the commandments of the \nd LORD\nd*, which he commanded
their fathers by the hand of Moses.

And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites,
and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:

And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their
daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the \nd LORD\nd*,
and forgat the \nd LORD\nd* their God, and served Baalim and the
groves.

Therefore the anger of the \nd LORD\nd* was hot against Israel,
and he sold them into the hand of Chushan-rishathaim king of Mesopotamia:
and the children of Israel served Chushan-rishathaim eight years.\f + \fr 3.8 
\ft Mesopotamia: Heb. Aram-naharaim\f*

And when the children of Israel cried unto the \nd LORD\nd*,
the \nd LORD\nd* raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel,
who delivered them, \add even\add* Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s
younger brother.\f + \fr 3.9  \ft deliverer: Heb. saviour\f*

And the Spirit of the \nd LORD\nd* came upon him, and he judged
Israel, and went out to war: and the \nd LORD\nd* delivered Chushan-rishathaim
king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed  against
Chushan-rishathaim.\f + \fr 3.10  \ft came: Heb. was\f*\f + \fr 3.10 
\ft Mesopotamia: Heb. Aram\f*

And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of
Kenaz died.

And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the

d LORD
d*: and the 
d LORD
d* strengthened Eglon the king of
Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the

d LORD
d*.

And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek,
and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.

So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen
years.

But when the children of Israel cried unto the \nd LORD\nd*,
the \nd LORD\nd* raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera,
a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel
sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.\f + \fr 3.15  \ft a Benjamite: or, the son of
Jemini\f*\f + \fr 3.15  \ft lefthanded: Heb. shut of his right hand\f*

But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit
length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon
\add was\add* a very fat man.

And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent
away the people that bare the present.

But he himself turned again from the quarries that \add were\add*
by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who
said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.\f + \fr 3.19 
\ft quarries: or, graven images\f*

And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour,
which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from
God unto thee. And he arose out of \add his\add* seat.\f + \fr 3.20 
\ft a summer…: Heb. a parlour of cooling\f*

And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his
right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:

And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed
upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly;
and the dirt came out.\f + \fr 3.22  \ft the dirt…: or, it came out at the
buttocks\f*

Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors
of the parlour upon him, and locked them.

When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw
that, behold, the doors of the parlour \add were\add* locked, they
said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.\f + \fr 3.24 
\ft covereth…: or, doeth his easement\f*

And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened
not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened
\add them:\add* and, behold, their lord \add was\add* fallen down
dead on the earth.

And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the
quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.

And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet
in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down
with him from the mount, and he before them.

And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the \nd LORD\nd*
hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went
down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered
not a man to pass over.

And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men,
all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.\f + \fr 3.29
