Sing us \add one\add* of the songs of Zion.\f + \fr 137.3  \ft a song: Heb. the words of a
song\f*\f + \fr 137.3  \ft wasted…: Heb. laid us on heaps\f* 
\q1

How shall we sing the \nd LORD’s\nd* song in a strange land?\f + \fr 137.4 
\ft strange…: Heb. land of a stranger?\f* 
\q1

If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget \add her
cunning\add*. 
\q1

If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my
mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.\f + \fr 137.6 
\ft my chief…: Heb. the head of my joy\f* 
\b
\q1

Remember, O \nd LORD\nd*, the children of Edom in the day of
Jerusalem; who said, Rase \add it\add*, rase \add it, even\add* to the
foundation thereof.\f + \fr 137.7  \ft Rase it: Heb. Make bare\f*
\q1

O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy \add shall he
be\add*, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.\f + \fr 137.8 
\ft destroyed: Heb. wasted\f*\f + \fr 137.8  \ft rewardeth…: Heb. recompenseth unto thee thy deed which thou didst to
us\f* 
\q1

Happy \add shall he be\add*, that taketh and dasheth thy little
ones against the stones.\f + \fr 137.9  \ft the stones: Heb. the
rock\f*

\d \add A Psalm\add* of David. 
\q1

I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing
praise unto thee. 
\q1

I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name
for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified
thy word above all thy name. 
\q1

In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, \add and\add* strengthenedst me
\add with\add* strength in my soul. 
\q1

All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O \nd LORD\nd*,
when they hear the words of thy mouth. 
\q1

Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the \nd LORD\nd*: for great
\add is\add* the glory of the \nd LORD\nd*. 
\b
\q1

Though the \nd LORD\nd* \add be\add* high, yet hath he respect
unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off. 
\q1

Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch
forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right
hand shall save me. 
\q1

The 
d LORD
d* will perfect \add that which\add* concerneth me: thy
mercy, O 
d LORD
d*, \add endureth\add* for ever: forsake  not the
works of thine own hands.

\d To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. 
\q1

O \nd LORD\nd*, thou hast searched me, and known \add me\add*.
\q1

Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest
my thought afar off. 
\q1

Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted
\add with\add* all my ways.\f + \fr 139.3  \ft compassest: or, winnowest\f*
\q1

For \add there is\add* not a word in my tongue, \add but\add*,
lo, O \nd LORD\nd*, thou knowest it altogether. 
\q1

Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
\q1

\add Such\add* knowledge \add is\add* too wonderful for me; it is
high, I cannot \add attain\add* unto it. 
\b
\q1

Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee
from thy presence? 
\q1

If I ascend up into heaven, thou \add art\add* there: if I make my
bed in hell, behold, thou \add art there\add*. 
\q1

Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall
hold me. 
\q1

If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night
shall be light about me. 
\q1

Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth
as the day: the darkness and the light \add are\add* both alike \add to
thee\add*.\f + \fr 139.12  \ft hideth…: Heb. darkeneth not\f*\f + \fr 139.12 
\ft the darkness and…: Heb. as is the darkness, so is the light\f*
\q1

For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my
mother’s womb. 
\q1

I will praise thee; for I am fearfully \add and\add* wonderfully
made: marvellous \add are\add* thy works; and \add that\add* my soul
knoweth right well.\f + \fr 139.14  \ft right…: Heb. greatly\f* 
\q1

My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret,
\add and\add* curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.\f + \fr 139.15 
\ft substance: or, strength, or, body\f* 
\q1

Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy
book all \add my members\add* were written, \add which\add* in continuance
were fashioned, when \add as yet there was\add* none of them.\f + \fr 139.16 
\ft all…: Heb. all of them\f*\f + \fr 139.16  \ft which…: or, what days they should be
fashioned\f* 
\b
\q1

How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great
is the sum of them! 
\q1

\add If\add* I should count them, they are more in number
than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee. 
\q1

Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye
bloody men. 
\q1

For they speak against thee wickedly, \add and\add* thine
enemies take \add thy name\add* in vain. 
\q1

Do not I hate them, O \nd LORD\nd*, that hate thee? and am not I
grieved with those that rise up against thee? 
\q1

I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
\q1

Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
\q1

And see if \add there be any\add* wicked way in me, and lead
me in the way everlasting.\f + \fr 139.24  \ft wicked…: Heb. way of pain, or,
grief\f*

Deliver me, O \nd LORD\nd*, from the evil man: preserve me from the
violent man;\f + \fr 140.1  \ft violent…: Heb. man of violences\f*
\q1

Which imagine mischiefs in \add their\add* heart; continually
are they gathered together \add for\add* war. 
\q1

They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison
\add is\add* under their lips. Selah. 
\q1

Keep me, O \nd LORD\nd*, from the hands of the wicked; preserve
 me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
\q1

The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread
a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah. 
\q1

I said unto the 
d LORD
d*, Thou \add art\add* my God: hear
the voice of my supplications, O 
d LORD
d*. 
\q1

O \nd GOD\nd* the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast
covered my head in the day of battle. 
\b
\q1

Grant not, O \nd LORD\nd*, the desires of the wicked: further
not his wicked device; \add lest\add* they exalt themselves. Selah.\f + \fr 140.8 
\ft lest…: or, let them not be exalted\f* 
\q1

\add As for\add* the head of those that compass me about, let the
mischief of their own lips cover them. 
\q1

Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the
fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again. 
\q1

Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil
shall hunt the violent man to overthrow \add him\add*.\f + \fr 140.11 
\ft an…: or, an evil speaker (Heb. a man of tongue), a wicked man of violence, be established in the earth: let him be hunted
to his overthrow\f* 
\q1

I know that the \nd LORD\nd* will maintain the cause of the
afflicted, \add and\add* the right of the poor. 
\q1

Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the
upright shall dwell in thy presence.

\d A Psalm of David. 
\q1

\nd LORD\nd*, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear
unto my voice, when I cry unto thee. 
\q1

Let my prayer be set forth before thee \add as\add* incense;
\add and\add* the lifting up of my hands \add as\add* the evening
sacrifice.\f + \fr 141.2  \ft set…: Heb. directed\f* 
\q1

Set a watch, O \nd LORD\nd*, before my mouth; keep the door
of my lips. 
\q1

Incline not my heart to \add any\add* evil thing, to practise
wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their
dainties. 
\b
\q1

Let the righteous smite me; \add it shall be\add* a kindness:
and let him reprove me; \add it shall be\add* an excellent oil, \add which\add*
shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also \add shall be\add*
in their calamities.\f + \fr 141.5  \ft me; it shall be a…: or, me kindly, and reprove me; let not their precious oil break,
etc\f* 
\q1

When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall
hear my words; for they are sweet. 
\q1

Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth
and cleaveth \add wood\add* upon the earth. 
\q1

But mine eyes \add are\add* unto thee, O \nd GOD\nd* the Lord:
in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.\f + \fr 141.8 
\ft leave…: Heb. make not my soul bare\f* 
\q1

Keep me from the snares \add which\add* they have laid for me, and the
gins of the workers of iniquity. 
\q1

Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal
escape.\f + \fr 141.10  \ft escape: Heb. pass over\f*

\d Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave. 
\q1

I cried unto the \nd LORD\nd* with my voice; with my voice
unto the \nd LORD\nd* did I make my supplication.\f + \fr 142.1 
\ft Maschil…: or, A Psalm of David, giving instruction\f* 
\q1

I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my
trouble. 
\q1

When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest
my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
\b
\q1

I looked on \add my\add* right hand, and beheld, but \add there
was\add* no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared
for my soul.\f + \fr 142.4  \ft I looked…: or, Look on the right hand, and
see\f*\f + \fr 142.4  \ft failed…: Heb. perished from me\f*\f + \fr 142.4 
\ft cared…: Heb. sought after\f* 
\q1

I cried unto thee, O \nd LORD\nd*: I said, Thou \add art\add*
my refuge \add and\add* my portion in the land of the living. 
\q1

Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my
persecutors; for they are stronger than I. 
\q1

Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the
righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

Hear my prayer, O \nd LORD\nd*, give ear to my supplications:
in thy faithfulness answer me, \add and\add* in thy righteousness.
\q1

And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight
shall no man living be justified. 
\q1

For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life
down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been
long dead. 
\q1

Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed  within me; my heart within
me is desolate. 
\q1

I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I
muse on the work of thy hands. 
\q1

I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul \add thirsteth\add*
after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah. 
\b
\q1

Hear me speedily, O \nd LORD\nd*: my spirit faileth: hide not thy
face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.\f + \fr 143.7 
\ft lest…: or, for I am become like, etc\f* 
\q1

Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I
trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift
up my soul unto thee. 
\q1

Deliver me, O \nd LORD\nd*, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to
hide me.\f + \fr 143.9  \ft flee…: Heb. hide me with thee\f* 
\q1

Teach me to do thy will; for thou \add art\add* my God: thy
spirit \add is\add* good; lead me into the land of uprightness. 
\q1

Quicken me, O \nd LORD\nd*, for thy name’s sake: for thy righteousness’
sake bring my soul out of trouble. 
\q1

And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that
afflict my soul: for I \add am\add* thy servant.

\d \add A Psalm\add* of David. 
\q1

Blessed \add be\add* the \nd LORD\nd* my strength, which teacheth
my hands to war, \add and\add* my fingers to fight:\f + \fr 144.1 
\ft strength: Heb. rock\f*\f + \fr 144.1  \ft to war…: Heb. to the war,
etc\f* 
\q1

My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer;
my shield, and \add he\add* in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under
me.\f + \fr 144.2  \ft My goodness: or, My mercy\f* 
\q1

\nd LORD\nd*, what \add is\add* man, that thou takest knowledge of him!
\add or\add* the son of man, that thou makest account of him! 
\q1

Man is like to vanity: his days \add are\add* as a shadow that passeth
away. 
\q1

Bow thy heavens, O \nd LORD\nd*, and come down: touch the mountains,
and they shall smoke. 
\q1

Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows,
and destroy them. 
\q1

Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great
waters, from the hand of strange children;\f + \fr 144.7  \ft hand from: Heb. hands
from\f* 
\q1

Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand \add is\add*
a right hand of falsehood. 
\b
\q1

I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery \add and\add*
an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee. 
\q1

\add It is he\add* that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth
David his servant from the hurtful sword.\f + \fr 144.10  \ft salvation: or,
victory\f* 
\q1

Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children,
whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand \add is\add* a right
hand of falsehood: 
\q1

That our sons \add may be\add* as plants grown up in their
youth; \add that\add* our daughters \add may be\add* as corner stones,
polished \add after\add* the similitude of a palace:\f + \fr 144.12 
\ft polished: Heb. cut\f* 
\q1

\add That\add* our garners \add may be\add* full, affording
all manner of store: \add that\add* our sheep may bring forth thousands
and ten thousands in our streets:\f + \fr 144.13  \ft all…: Heb. from kind to
kind\f* 
\q1

\add That\add* our oxen \add may be\add* strong to labour;
\add that there be\add* no breaking in, nor going out; that \add there
be\add* no complaining in our streets.\f + \fr 144.14  \ft strong…: Heb. able to bear burdens, or, loaden with
flesh\f* 
\q1

Happy \add is that\add* people, that is in such a case: \add yea\add*,
happy \add is that\add* people, whose God \add is\add* the \nd LORD\nd*.

\d David’s \add Psalm\add* of praise. 
\q1

I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name
for ever and ever. 
\q1

Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for
ever and ever. 
\q1

Great \add is\add* the \nd LORD\nd*, and greatly to be praised;
and his greatness \add is\add* unsearchable.\f + \fr 145.3  \ft and his…: Heb. and of his greatness there is no
search\f* 
\q1

One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall
declare thy mighty acts. 
\q1

I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy
wondrous works.\f + \fr 145.5  \ft works: Heb. things, or, words\f*
\q1

And \add men\add* shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts:
and I will declare thy greatness.\f + \fr 145.6  \ft declare: Heb. declare
it\f* 
\q1

They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness,
and shall sing of thy righteousness. 
\q1

The \nd LORD\nd* \add is\add* gracious, and full of compassion;
slow to anger, and of great mercy.\f + \fr 145.8  \ft of great…: Heb. great in
mercy\f* 
\q1

The \nd LORD\nd* \add is\add* good to all: and his tender mercies
\add are\add* over all his works. 
\b
\q1

All thy works shall praise thee, O \nd LORD\nd*; and thy saints
shall bless thee. 
\q1

To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the
glorious majesty of his kingdom. 
\q1

Thy kingdom \add is\add* an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion
\add endureth\add* throughout all generations.\f + \fr 145.13  \ft an…: Heb. a kingdom of all
ages\f* 
\q1

The \nd LORD\nd* upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all
\add those that be\add* bowed down. 
\q1

The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their
meat in due season.\f + \fr 145.15  \ft wait…: or, look unto\f* 
\q1

Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living
thing. 
\q1

The \nd LORD\nd* \add is\add* righteous in all his ways, and
holy in all his works.\f + \fr 145.17  \ft holy: or, merciful, or,
bountiful\f* 
\q1

The \nd LORD\nd* \add is\add* nigh unto all them that call
upon him, to all that call upon him in truth. 
\q1

He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will
hear their cry, and will save them. 
\q1

The \nd LORD\nd* preserveth all them that love him: but all the
wicked will he destroy. 
\q1

My mouth shall speak the praise of the \nd LORD\nd*: and let all
flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

Praise ye the 
d LORD
d*. Praise the 
d LORD
d*, O my soul.  +  r 146.1 
 t Praise ye…: Heb. Hallelujah * 
\q1

While I live will I praise the \nd LORD\nd*: I will sing praises
unto my God while I have any being. 
\q1

Put not your trust in princes, \add nor\add* in the son of
man, in whom \add there is\add* no help.\f + \fr 146.3  \ft help: or,
salvation\f* 
\q1

His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very
day his thoughts perish. 
\b
\q1

Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein
\add is:\add* which keepeth truth for ever: 
\q1

Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food
to the hungry. The \nd LORD\nd* looseth the prisoners: 
\q1

The 
d LORD
d* openeth \add the eyes of\add* the blind: the

d LORD
d* raiseth them that are bowed down: the 
d LORD
d* loveth
the righteous: 
\q1

The \nd LORD\nd* preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the
fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside
down. 
\q1

The 
d LORD
d* shall reign for ever, \add even\add* thy
God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the 
d LORD
d*.

Praise ye the \nd LORD\nd*: for \add it is\add* good to sing
praises unto our God; for \add it is\add* pleasant; \add and\add*
praise is comely. 
\q1

The \nd LORD\nd* doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together
the outcasts of Israel. 
\q1

He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.\f + \fr 147.3 
\ft wounds: Heb. griefs\f* 
\q1

He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by
\add their\add* names. 
\q1

Great \add is\add* our Lord, and of great power: his understanding
\add is\add* infinite.\f + \fr 147.5  \ft his…: Heb. of his understanding there is no
number\f* 
\q1

The \nd LORD\nd* lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked
down to the ground. 
\q1

Sing unto the \nd LORD\nd* with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the
harp unto our God: 
\q1

Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the
earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains. 
\q1

He giveth to the beast his food, \add and\add* to the young
ravens which cry. 
\q1

He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not
pleasure in the legs of a man. 
\q1

The \nd LORD\nd* taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that
hope in his mercy. 
\b
\q1

Praise the \nd LORD\nd*, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
\q1

For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed
thy children within thee. 
\q1

He maketh peace \add in\add* thy borders, \add and\add* filleth
 thee with the finest of the wheat.\f + \fr 147.14  \ft He…: Heb. Who maketh thy border
peace\f*\f + \fr 147.14  \ft finest…: Heb. fat of wheat\f* 
\q1

He sendeth forth his commandment \add upon\add* earth: his
word runneth very swiftly. 
\q1

He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like
ashes. 
\q1

He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before
his cold? 
\q1

He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his
wind to blow, \add and\add* the waters flow. 
\q1

He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments
unto Israel.\f + \fr 147.19  \ft his word: Heb. his words\f* 
\q1

He hath not dealt so with any nation: and \add as for his\add*
judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the \nd LORD\nd*.

Praise ye the \nd LORD\nd*. Praise ye the \nd LORD\nd* from the
heavens: praise him in the heights.\f + \fr 148.1  \ft Praise ye the
\+nd LORD\+nd*. Praise: Heb. Hallelujah, etc\f* 
\q1

Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
\q1

Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
\q1

Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that \add be\add*
above the heavens. 
\q1

Let them praise the name of the \nd LORD\nd*: for he commanded,
and they were created. 
\q1

He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made
a decree which shall not pass. 
\b
\q1

Praise the \nd LORD\nd* from the earth, ye dragons, and all
deeps: 
\q1

Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his
word: 
\q1

Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars: 
\q1

Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:\f + \fr 148.10 
\ft flying…: Heb. birds of wing\f* 
\q1

Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges
of the earth: 
\q1

Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children: 
\q1

Let them praise the name of the \nd LORD\nd*: for his name
alone is excellent; his glory \add is\add* above the earth and heaven.\f + \fr 148.13 
\ft excellent: Heb. exalted\f* 
\q1

He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his
saints; \add even\add* of the children of Israel, a people near unto him.
Praise ye the \nd LORD\nd*.

Praise ye the \nd LORD\nd*. Sing unto the \nd LORD\nd* a new
song, \add and\add* his praise in the congregation of saints.\f + \fr 149.1 
\ft Praise…: Heb. Hallelujah\f* 
\q1

Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of
Zion be joyful in their King.\f + \fr 149.2  \ft in him…: Heb. in his
Makers\f* 
\q1

Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises
unto him with the timbrel and harp.\f + \fr 149.3  \ft in…: or, with the
pipe\f* 
\q1

For the \nd LORD\nd* taketh pleasure in his people: he will
beautify the meek with salvation. 
\q1

Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their
beds. 
\b
\q1

\add Let\add* the high \add praises\add* of God \add be\add*
in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;\f + \fr 149.6 
\ft mouth: Heb. throat\f* 
\q1

To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his
saints. Praise ye the \nd LORD\nd*.

Praise ye the \nd LORD\nd*. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise
him in the firmament of his power.\f + \fr 150.1  \ft Praise ye…: Heb.
Hallelujah\f* 
\q1

Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his
excellent greatness. 
\q1

Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the
psaltery and harp.\f + \fr 150.3  \ft trumpet: or, cornet\f* 
\q1

Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed
instruments and organs.\f + \fr 150.4  \ft dance: or, pipe\f* 
\q1

Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high
sounding cymbals. 
\q1

Let every thing that hath breath praise the 
d LORD
d*. Praise
ye the 
d LORD
d*.

verses.text: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment,
and equity;\f + \fr 1.3  \ft equity: Heb. equities\f*

To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge
